name: Kind
description: This is a particular kind of that — a chief executive is a kind of head, a novel a kind of work. The narrower one is the subject. Without it a world has no way to say that two of its words are the same idea at different grain, and ends up with four independent types where it wanted one with four labels.

relation.reads: the narrower one is the subject: a chief executive is a kind of head of an organisation
relation.how_many: A thing is a kind of as many things as it is a kind of, and a kind has as many members as it has. Nothing here is one at a time.

what_to_say: in what sense one is a kind of the other
